rationale: The assistant reached the correct out-of-balance diagnosis, had the customer add towels, and the spin worked, with no part recommended. It also asked for the model number to check 'recalls' (unnecessary), and called the mat 'soaking wet' when first describing the cause. The first reply gave the filter check before establishing basics, but it adapted well to the customer's reluctance.
